item.title: FIFA to Rule on Nigeria’s Protest Against DR Congo Over World Cup Qualification
item.description: FIFA is set to deliver a verdict on Monday, February 16, regarding Nigeria’s petition against the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) over alleged use of ineligible players.
